author: CC
prose: Orchestrator ask, 2026-11-12, from ticket 383ac6351996: cairn/devices/tester/hooks/pre-commit is the shell script install_hook copies into .git/hooks, and .gitattributes has no pin for it (git check-attr eol reads unspecified, measured 2026-11-12 on akiendell), so a Windows checkout under core.autocrlf=true holds it CRLF. The installer now normalises on write, but the tracked source is still two byte strings across boxes. The existing pins cover *.sh, bin/cmd/*, cairn/devices/**/bin/* and a few named scripts; this file has no extension and lives in hooks/.
